Definition: from G746 and G4864; director of the synagogue services:--(chief) ruler of the synagogue.
BiblicalUsage: The ruler of the synagogue directed its services, and the word follows the gospel's hardest moments. Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, falls at Jesus' feet for his dying daughter, a messenger comes from the ruler's house saying she is dead, Crispus the chief ruler believes with all his house, and the rulers of the synagogue invite Paul to speak a word of exhortation.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the rulers of the synagogue show both sides of the gospel's welcome. Some fall at Jesus' feet and some invite Paul to speak, and the synagogue that was meant to keep the law becomes the place where the gospel is first heard.
